hints.content: We have two tapes that are the same length. Let's start by writing an expression for the length of each tape.
The top tape has a length of $63$ units.

The bottom tape has $7$ parts, each with a length of $m$ units.

The total length of the bottom tape is $7\times m$ units, which we can simplify to $7m$ units.

So, the tape diagram shows us $63=7m$.

The section labeled $m$ is $\dfrac{1}{7}$ the length of the $63$ unit long tape.

$m=\dfrac{63}{7}={}?$
